snippet.title: Project Arrhythmia - Story Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/440310/Project_Arrhythmia/

Description: 
Project Arrhythmia is a new take on the classic SHMUP / Bullet Hell genre. This time, everything is synced to the music.

You dodge the rhythmically timed shapes as you navigate through each song; no shooting required.
Each level is designed to evoke a sense of synesthesia within you from start to finish, just as if you were actually “playing” a music video.

Socials:
BlueSky: https://bsky.app/profile/vitamin.games
Discord: https://discord.gg/projectarrhythmia
Website: https://vitamin.games

Featuring Music By:
Akira Complex / Chipzel / Shirobon / Meganeko / Andrew Allanson / Creo / and More!
